verdict.rationale: Graphite installs as a GitHub App (docs-9, docs-48). AI reviews can then be enabled in a few clicks with no configuration (docs-18), automatically review every new PR in the selected repos (docs-19), and give feedback 'instantly' (docs-4); comment exclusions confirm the agent leaves comments on PRs (docs-20). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that reviews post as native inline GitHub PR comments rather than only in Graphite's own review UI, GitLab support (a community user says it lacks GitLab, comm-9), and independent hands-on corroboration of turnaround time.
